messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Math and Stan getting tagged in the next hour unless there's some objection
parts:
Hi Bob!

What happened was that the CVODE library got swapped out for the CVODES library. Since the CVODES library is source compatible to CVODE client code this worked without any change to the integrate_ode_cvode function which has been in math and is unchanged.

Let's discuss during the meeting, but I would actually suggest to change the name of the function integrate_ode_cvode to integrate_ode_bdf before we tag. We could possibly do this in the language stan? This is just an idea in order to avoid having a growing list of function names to deprecate.

In 2.11 we would then change the implementation of the cvode integrator to the one which is currently under review - and things would only get faster, no other change.

I hope the design of the CVODES branch I wrote is now as everyone agreed to in their minds.

Sebastian

@ Ben: For rstan CVODES will be distributed, so we won't have to change anything there in the future. However, could you please double-check that all printf statements are ifdefed-out. I mean when changing to CVODES, I took over the patches you had put into CVODE, but please have a final look to make sure that CVODES did not introduce more. Thanks!
